definition: Login -> search returns target -> access and authenticated initial WS snapshot -> Redis save ACK and canonical commit; 2000ms per stage, no automatic retry. Cohorts assigned by flow start, not completion.
limitations: Artificial fault mix; not production uptime/SLA or annual availability.
Repeated requests during the same outage are correlated; Wilson intervals are binomial reference intervals, not independent trial guarantees.
A timeout may still be saved later; timeout is not proof of data loss.
Stage success rates condition on reaching that stage; end-to-end rate includes failures at any earlier stage.
